mainEntity.name: Can a foreign company hire in India without incorporating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement allows a foreign company to engage India-based employees through Jobman Global's local employing entity. Jobman handles employment contracts, payroll, PF/ESI statutory compliance, and tax withholding while the foreign company directs the employee's day-to-day work.

mainEntity.name: When should we establish our own legal entity in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Establishing a legal entity (such as a wholly owned subsidiary) is preferable when your India presence requires direct commercial billing, large-scale hiring (15+ employees), long-term capital investment, or full operational control. Jobman Global supports full incorporation, tax registrations, and ongoing compliance.

mainEntity.name: Where does Jobman Global deliver services across India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobman Global delivers services nationwide across all Indian states and union territories. Operational delivery and management are anchored in Bengaluru, Karnataka, providing seamless pan-India coverage across Tier-1 metros and Tier-2/3 commercial hubs.

mainEntity.name: Can Jobman Global support an existing Indian company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Jobman Global supports Indian startups and established domestic businesses with specialist recruitment, flexible contract staffing, third-party payroll, accounting/MIS, and statutory compliance coordination without coordinating multiple vendors.

mainEntity.name: Does Jobman Global only serve European clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Jobman Global supports businesses worldwide, including North America, the UK, Europe, Singapore, Australia, and the Middle East. The Basel office provides European clients with an accessible regional point of contact while service delivery is anchored in Bengaluru, India.

mainEntity.name: Can an EOR team later transition to our own Indian legal entity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A seamless transition can be planned and executed to migrate employees from the EOR model into your newly incorporated entity without operational interruption.
